evidence.note: Serif title, sans subtitle, italic byline; generous whitespace with soft blue blobs; nav and running header consistent with every other slide.
Clean three-node loop with colour-coded blue/red reward paths and check badges; definition tile sits under the scorer it explains; nothing collides.
Numbered timeline left, server/internet zone diagram centre, quote tile right; same kicker/title/tile styling as s-2 and s-5; layout uncluttered.

Folder grid, coordinator dots, document icon and scorer node pack tightly around the package mirror; document icon sits on edge lines near the scorer card; densest region of the deck but still legible, with a clear legend.
Insight pop-over uses the same card treatment and serif body as on s-4 step 7 and s-5 step 9; background blur consistent.

Three evenly spaced cards with matching serif headings, blue bullets, italic quote and linked sources; a faint blurred ghost of the previous diagram and legend shows behind and below the cards, slightly muddying the background.
Centred 'Thank you' echoes the title slide's background treatment.

rationale: Typography, cards, tiles, kickers and overlays are applied consistently across all slides, and the diagrams are purposeful step-built visuals with no colliding labels, which rises well above the generic level 3. Two spots fall a little below the rest: the crowded mirror/scorer cluster on s-5 late steps and the blurred diagram residue behind the s-9 cards. That matches level 4: considered throughout with one or two slides below the rest.
